description: This is a unit test class for the DittoDurationValueValidator, which tests its behavior and validation logic for duration values in the Ditto project.

classes.name: DittoDurationValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DittoDurationValueValidator, confirming validation logic and immutability.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static data for testing, specifically a valid DittoDuration string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the DittoDurationValueValidator class instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that providing null as value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateDittoDuration
methods.description: Verifies that the validator recognizes DittoDuration class for validation.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that a valid duration string is accepted without errors.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotDittoDuration
methods.description: Ensures that strings not matching the DittoDuration type can still be processed without exception.

methods.name: acceptNonDittoDurationString
methods.description: Tests that invalid duration strings like 'true' are rejected with proper exception.

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Tests rejection of negative duration values.

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithInvalidTimeUnit
methods.description: Tests rejection of duration strings with unsupported time units, such as hours in this context.
